contract_precheck.notes: Scoped requirements have Plan source references and observable acceptance checks. Assumed live-provider compatibility is explicitly constrained by Spec R10 and provider_policy; live calls were not required for this boundary audit.

evidence.detail: Implementation check record reviewed; this audit independently reran the listed checks and additional vision IPC test.
Matches supplied routing evidence hash; filename in candidate includes screenshot-vision prefix.

Passed models-vision.unit.test.js, models-vision-ipc.unit.test.js, models-thinking.unit.test.js, pet-actions-v5-config.unit.test.js, pet-actions-v5-settings.e2e.test.js, node --check for changed JS modules, and git diff --check over candidate range.

Timeout and external abort are wired to request signal; finally cleanup clears timer and removes listener. Image request sends one PNG data URI and returns only final textual content after nonblank validation (lines 59-90).
Prompt preserves source wording/language, numbers, code indentation and table relationships; marks unclear text, declines image instructions/questions, and requests objective visual description.
Existing model validation IPC routes declared multimodal LLMs to explicit image validation while preserving ASR and text validation paths; behavioral unit test covers all routes.

limitations: No live provider request or key/profile read was performed. Synthetic fixture checks and mocked HTTP behavior do not establish compatibility or transcription quality for any provider; Spec R10 remains for later acceptance.
P5 workflow, button state, clipboard publication, and integration are outside this audit boundary.

next_cycle_brief.objective: Implement and verify P5 image workflow and button integration against the frozen contract, preserving the P4 provider method and validation route.
allowed_changes: P5 implementation changes supported by requirements and integration evidence
checks: Cover clipboard image and model capability gating, frozen provider/image snapshot, operation arbitration, successful text clipboard publication, failure non-publication, and renderer state refresh.
carry_forward: R10 live provider compatibility and quality remains unverified until its preflight and fixture gate passes
P5 is not implemented or audited here
